title: The look
blurb: The house look every film is drawn in: the paper-cut knobs, K1, seven other styles, then K1-minimal (9005).

versions.title: K1 paper-cut
versions.because: K1 picked after watching the Opening set: a thick outline with a light inner edge, warm ink, a hue per garment, the head a third

versions.title: Seven other styles
versions.because: Try other 2D styles that are stylistic, attractive, expressive and minimal: seven prototypes, one in the Paper Mario line

versions.title: Concept art, then K1-minimal
versions.because: The seed concept art is liked: can it be rendered and animated reliably?

versions.title: 9005: K1-minimal, plain
versions.because: 9005 picked: one-shape heads with an inner edge, a flat beard, plain clothes, the crease, grain and cast shadows

said.text: Open choices go ahead on the agents' recommendations, provisionally, as knobs
K1 is the paper-cut look (A3 + B1 + C2 + D2)
The cast's hair often looks strange; the heads look stitched on
Prototype seven 2D styles; one in the Paper Mario line, the rest widely different
said.quote: maybe prototype for another of 2d art style thats stylistic, attactive, expressive and minimal? use seeds to generate a number and then try - use max, lets go for 7 prototypes

said.text: Can the concept art be animated reliably? Make a K1 concept too, and render against it
said.quote: i like a lot of the concept art that we had made with the seeds, but can we reliably animate that?

said.text: K1 minimal: the gripe with K1 was hair and ornaments; clothes plain but for distinguishing marks
said.quote: minimal when it comes to k1 - my main gripe with k1 was hair and ornaments

said.text: Mid-century Shapes and Riso are dropped
said.quote: no need for mid century or riso

said.text: Explore the One Line concept: give it the storyboard-to-render treatment
said.quote: also lets try exploring the one line concept - i kinda like it, give it the storyboard -> render etc treatment
